name: search-hub.setpoint-read
purpose: Read every row of search-hub's improve setpoint in one submission and report each as in band, out of band, or unavailable, without estimating.

window_token.description: TimeWindowToken enum name for the three declared measures.

insights_window.description: insights window: bare integer days, or a duration such as 15m.

routing_suite.description: Composed routing suite whose newest run gives the precision, pass-rate, and recall rows.

assumptions: search-hub is running and its evals, metrics, insights, and federation bindings are reachable from the kernel
the caller treats an unavailable row as unknown, never as zero
the newest router.routing run may be a strategy-compare candidate arm; the rows carry the tag so the caller does not mistake it for the incumbent
no eval suite records a floor; the eval-floors row reports the newest pass rates with reason pending_telemetry and no band until a floor is recorded
invariants: no binding with effect write or destructive is called
no row set is materialized; every reading is head(1), meta, count, or filter
the envelope is printed exactly once, on every path

row reason values are the closed vocabulary in program-contracts.md; a permanent reason (pending_telemetry, unreliable:*) does not lower the status, only a transient scenario_unreachable row or a failed read makes the board partial
no floor is invented: a row whose band is not recorded reports target null and in_band null

signals.rows: list of {row, reading, target, in_band, unavailable, reason} in the improve skill's table order: routing-precision, e2e-pass-rate, retrieval-recall, provider-degradation, degraded-query-rate, federated-latency, under-utilized-providers, zero-result-rate, provider-reachability, eval-floors; target and in_band are null for eval-floors
signals.readable: count of rows read from a governed binding and banded
signals.unavailable: count of rows marked unavailable, permanent reasons included
signals.unavailable_transient: count of unavailable rows whose reason is not permanent (scenario_unreachable or a failed read); the only count that lowers the status

outputs.evidence: sensor command names and search-hub://eval-run/<run_id> references

fixtures.note: eval-floors is pending_telemetry by construction and does not lower the status; partial means a transient read failed.
